definition: Upcoming = CDOT public-way event permits (festival, parade, athletic, assembly, sidewalk sale, block party) and Park District event reservations (event tiers 1 to 6, plus civic, corporate or philanthropic venue rentals that name an organization) starting in the 120 days after 2026-11-17, the newest processed or issued date in the CDOT table. Permits cancelled or denied are left out; a permit is one row however many street segments it covers. Recurring = CDOT festival, parade, athletic and assembly series and Park District event series that took place in at least 2 of the last 3 twelve-month seasons ending on the as-of date, with an expected next window of the same dates one year on, plus or minus the spread seen (at least 7 days). A targeting list: no chance of hiring anyone is modelled.
privacy: Applicants who are individuals are never stored or shown. An organizer name appears only when it looks like an organization; ambiguous names are withheld.

contactMatch.note: A contact suggestion is a name match between the organizer and a public business listing (Overture Maps or Chicago business licenses): exact normalized name, or a near-identical name with all differing words typo-level similar; single-word names and names shared by several businesses are never matched. It can be a different organization with the same name, so verify before use. Nothing is guessed: no email patterns, no personal contacts.
